objective: Finish BUKLOD Community Wall display patches: shared post-card shell, one-line captions with large text-only posts, and Android original photo clarity.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: independent production release evidence recorded in PR #515 identifies Android OTA 01a1afda-304b-72a7-a859-8799f25ac602 on runtime 1.3.2 and source 8e1956e617a65b3350b3fba81597fc86604da4a1. The main branch is a DEV integration baseline, not automatic proof of the installed APK; this PR has no production or staging OTA.
chosenApproach: Selective integration of card presentation from PR #506 and native original-photo transfer from PR #515 over verified caption PR #516 without replacing current main collage and video engines.
selectionRationale: Composes existing renderers in a shared shell and extends platform-specific image cache promotion. Avoids merging diverged branches or overwriting main video/photo paths.
